title: The Apocalypse of John (Revelation)
author: Attributed to John of Patmos
edition_reference: SBLGNT (SBL Greek New Testament; Logos Bible Software / Society of Biblical Literature)
license: CC BY 4.0 (SBLGNT). The Greek New Testament text itself is in the public domain by virtue of age; SBLGNT's editorial decisions are CC BY 4.0.
provenance_note: SBLGNT differs from NA28 in 540+ variation units; chosen because it is freely usable under CC BY 4.0 while NA28's published apparatus is copyrighted. The text is a critically edited Greek New Testament suitable for scholarly use. NA28 may be cited for the apparatus by canonical reference rather than reproduction.
constitutional_role: First New Testament composition per the Revelation First research project. A canonical text of the descent — apocalyptic vision-literature in the strict sense.
